summary.text: Samuel Douglass, a Republican from Troy, represented the Orleans district in the Vermont Senate from 2025 until he resigned on October 27, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Douglass was born in Newport City, grew up in Jay and North Troy, and attended North Country Union High School, according to his Senate biography.
He worked in food service, hospitality and mental health while earning his degree at Johnson State College.

Outside the legislature he works for Lamoille County Mental Health Services as a Crisis Interventionist and for Great Northern Land Company as an Agent Associate, and he operates an organic family farm and farmstand.
He serves as a Justice of the Peace in Troy and previously served as a Lister for the town.
